base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT p.XCL_058,
       CASE WHEN l.XCL_021 BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'within normal range' ELSE 'not within normal range' END AS albumin_status
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.XCL_014 = p.XCL_058
WHERE substr(p.XCL_060,1,4) = '1982'
